title: Manyhands JSON v1 repository removal preview
description: The data of a prepare envelope that gives a preview of repo remove: what the removal will do, and the confirmation an execute of the same command and repository presents to do it. A prepare that gives no preview carries no preview data: a rejection, and a no-op for a repository that is not registered.

confirmation_id.description: What an execute presents as its consent. It is accepted by one request.

expires_at.description: When the confirmation stops being accepted by a new request: ten minutes after the preview. A request that has accepted it is honored afterwards.

command.description: The command the confirmation is for, as an envelope names it.

effects.description: What the command will do, in the order it does it.

details.description: The registration that will be removed. The command removes the repository from the repository list and drops what Manyhands cached of it, and nothing else.

root.description: The registered root, as the repository list gives it.

enabled_at.description: When the repository was registered, as the repository list gives it.

files_changed.description: Whether the command changes or removes any file under the root, the directory Manyhands keeps its worktrees in among them. It never does: this is false.

git_state_changed.description: Whether the command changes anything Git holds: a commit, a branch, a worktree, the index or the configuration. It never does: this is false.
